title: Retune P104 twin-rung-removal to the certified tuning ceiling (kappa 0.003125811556925)
body:
## Summary

Retunes the P104 helper-470 twin-rung-removal family from κ = 0.003125804 (PR6030) to **κ = 0.003125811556925017** — the exact column-generation optimum of the 12-parameter tuning lattice. This is +2.418 ppm over the current record, and it lands the record **at the certified tuning ceiling**: at these parameters every lattice direction has reduced cost zero, so no further parameter tuning in this family can raise κ.

## What changed

Four files in `research/p104-helper470-twin-rung-removal/`, all parameter-surface only — the construction, word, chain, and inventory are untouched:

- `pricing.py`: `KAPPA, TESTED` move to exact integer-pair fractions (κ = 302309943873316514383698715459862241/96714065569170333976494080000000000000, TESTED = KAPPA + 2⁻⁶⁰, keeping gap = 1/(7·2⁶⁰) with numerator 1 for the compiler integer grid); `PREVIOUS` advances to the displaced PR6030 record; the display label follows.
- `PRICING-EDITS.json`: the three new literal edit pairs, declared per the chain's edit-attribution convention.
- `RESULT.json`: regenerated receipt from the full replay.
- `EXPECT.json`: status label carries the new claim (KAPPA_3125811556925).

## Verification

End-to-end, in this tree, exact rational arithmetic throughout:

- `verify.py` (chain part): authenticated PR5827 source chain, regenerated `WORD.json.gz` byte-for-byte, exact replay, storage inventory, paid/target deltas, all 799 input columns, native maps, complete physical caller — **PASS**
- Both moment engines agree; raw root interval unchanged (same inventory): `[312581155791/10^14, 19536322237/6250000000000]` — the new κ sits strictly below `lower` with the strictification tail margins intact (α < 1 − 10⁻¹², γ/δ < 125/128)
- All 54 outer strict checks + 4 functional checks positive; compiler threshold H finite with predecessor rejection; negative controls (wrong cutoff, old completion, old offset, insufficient BIT contract) all rejected
- `test_portability.py`: **PASS**
- `verify.py` assert mode against the regenerated receipt: **PASS**

## Why this value

The parameter vector is the certified LP optimum over the full lattice: column generation with exact duals (pricing = d(κ)/d(parameter) per frozen row) converges here with all reduced costs ≤ 1e-6; the ceiling is interval-certified by exact bisection against the moment root ρ ∈ [0.003125811557911897 ± 1e-25]; optimality gap 2.8e-16 relative. At the optimum the only binding wall is the strictification tail reserve — next gains require rank-inventory (construction) changes, not tuning.

Analysis and optimality certificate: MultiAgency (darkhipo), column generation with exact rational arithmetic. All construction credit and predecessor attribution unchanged from PR6030 and its sources.
